status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; no device reads this file yet. Format: docs/records/design-reviews/io-contract-modules.md > 5.
goal: The cycle's branch on the remote at the commit the quality evaluation scored, the change shown working above its own tests, and a draft pull request open with CI green on its head — or CI's not running recorded on it — whose body lets the operator decide on it.

tool_requests.note: Besides the criteria, the PR body owes the operator the run's tool requests (§5.3) and the recommendations the Coordinator deferred or separated. Each is a run's tool-requests.json.

deferred.note: a JSON array of the recommendations the Coordinator deferred or separated, each {subject, finding, disposition}: the disposition is the issue that takes it (#<n>, or <owner>/<repo>#<n>) or the gap stated in one line

checks.note: the head's checks are all green, or the body records that no CI ran with the marker line

integration.note: how the change was shown working above its own tests, and what that showed

result.summary: one line, with the pull request's URL and head
